canonical_statement: There exist a probability space and a real-valued stochastic process indexed by nonnegative real time which starts at zero, has independent Gaussian increments with variance t-s for s <= t, and has almost surely continuous sample paths.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: Ω : Type u; time ℝ≥0; values ℝ; P : Measure Ω; Prop in a universe induced by the existential carrier
quantifiers: there exists a carrier Ω and measurable-space structure
there exists P : Measure Ω with IsProbabilityMeasure P
there exists W : ℝ≥0 -> Ω -> ℝ
conclusion: W starts at zero, has the standard independent Gaussian increment laws, and has P-almost-sure continuous paths

alternate_encodings.target: canonical continuous-path space with Wiener measure and coordinate process
alternate_encodings.relationship: expected to witness the existential abstract-space statement
strengthens/packages the usual root with Gaussian-process and natural-filtration fields
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none under rev-5.6; legacy code is discovery only

degenerate_and_boundary_cases: Time zero and equal-time increments must be covered. Negative time is excluded by the ℝ≥0 index. Null or non-probability measures are excluded. No positive-dimensional or drifted/scaled Brownian motion is substituted.
scope_exclusions: finite-dimensional Gaussian distributions without a path-space construction
Brownian motion with unspecified path regularity
multidimensional, drifted, or scaled variants as substitutes
